info.title: Puls Finance Director
info.summary: Structured, risk-managed prediction portfolio sized to your balance for $0.50 via Circle Nanopayments (x402) on Arc.
info.description: The highest-tier Puls agent product: an AI Finance Director analyzes your wallet, win rate and open positions, then returns a structured prediction-market basket with sizing, risk profile and a money-back guarantee when enabled. NOTE: this endpoint combines x402 payment with Supabase authentication (Bearer token) — it is aimed at logged-in Puls users; keyless agents should use the other Bazaar services. Payment via x402: a request without payment returns HTTP 402 with a base64 PAYMENT-REQUIRED header; retry with a payment-signature header to receive the plan plus a PAYMENT-RESPONSE settlement header.

post.summary: Paid AI Finance Director portfolio plan ($0.50 USDC)

402.description: Payment required. A base64 PAYMENT-REQUIRED header carries the x402 v2 requirements (scheme exact, network eip155:5042002, USDC, amount 500000 atomic units).

200.description: Portfolio plan delivered after successful x402 settlement.
